content: A bounded fixture for validating the Grok-to-Obsidian bridge. External claims in a real run require source URLs and an independent verifier.

candidates.name: Fixture documentation tool
candidates.why: May reduce stale API usage during coding.
candidates.expected_benefit: Fewer implementation retries caused by outdated documentation.
candidates.acceptance_test: Complete one version-sensitive implementation task with and without the tool and compare factual errors.
candidates.independent_checker: Deterministic test suite plus a different model
candidates.rollback: Remove the tool registration and restore the baseline run record.
candidates.human_gate: Dillon approves promotion after the checker passes.
candidates.overlap: Compare with OpenAI Developer Docs and existing Cursor documentation tools.
